messages:
jamie_ops: Heads up — our EU H100 tranche for next-week staging just dropped to T-2. Vendor says 18 units are on a partial hold due to a customs paperwork mismatch. Need alignment on prioritization + return routing.
lia_vendor: Sorry, working the hold now. Customs flagged HS code on 9 serials (batch S-992). We can either reclassify (48-72h) or request an expedited temporary import with brokerage (cost ~€900/unit).
sam_logistics: If we reclassify, ETA slips to mid-next-week (72h), air expedite brings them in 24-36h but needs AWB change and tariff deposit. Which do we prefer?
jamie_ops: Tradeoff: our infra is throttling some batch jobs — alex_infra, how bad is the impact if we lose ~9 H100s for 3 days?
alex_infra: Cluster is at 82% peak utilization in eu-west-1. Losing 9 H100s would push some live queues into degraded mode; autoscaling will fallback to smaller instances and queuing latency will double on the ml-training tenant. Estimated customer impact: increased tail latency, potential backpressure on feature store writes.
sasha_pm: We have a canary rollout scheduled that depends on the extra capacity. Delay will postpone rollout and might push the release window. Product prefers expedite if cost approved.
matt_finance: Ballpark — expedite adds ~€8.1k total, reclassify is free but with SLA risk. If expedite prevents SLA credits and rollout delay, likely worth it. Need formal approval.
lia_vendor: Also a partial RMA on 2 units came back from depot with missing serials; vendor can consolidate replacements into the same AWB if we instruct now. That saves a separate courier cost (~€1200).
jamie_ops: Okay — propose: expedite customs for the 9 units, consolidate the 2 replacement RMA units into the same AWB, and accept the additional fee. Sam, can you confirm routing plan and a single AWB?
sam_logistics: Can do. Draft routing: origin FRA depot -> exp. air -> AMS hub -> eu-west-1 staging. Single AWB feasible if vendor signs off today. ETA if we ship today: 36h.
lia_vendor: Vendor confirmed they can sign AWB consolidation but need PO amendment and credit hold release. PO: PO-78421.
matt_finance: I can sign the amendment for the expedite charge up to €9k. Please attach updated invoice and a short justification for audit.
sasha_pm: Adding justification: Prevent rollout delay + SLA exposure for two enterprise customers.
jamie_ops: Alex, quick ops ask — if we receive the consolidated AWB, can we pre-stage kube-node images and warm the KV cache to reduce warmup latency? Any config to run?
alex_infra: Yes. Pre-pull images and pre-warm RK cacheer: run on infra admin pool:
```
rdctl node prep --region eu-west-1 --count 18 --image h100-runtime:v2.1
rdctl cache warm --model gpt-4x-h100 --prefix  /canary/promptset --workers 8
```
That will shave ~20-30% of cold start. Need perms for rdctl run; tag nodes as "vendor-expedite" for traceability.
jamie_ops: Noted. Sam, lia — do the paperwork today. Lia, add manifest with serials and the two replacement serials to AWB.
lia_vendor: Will do. I will upload MAN-78421 and update PO. Created RMA ticket RM-8921 for the replacements.
deploybot: RM-8921 created by lia_vendor for PO-78421. Status: pending vendor sign-off.
sam_logistics: Once RM ticket is attached we trigger AWB consolidation and courier pickup ETA 6pm CET today.
matt_finance: Uploaded provisional invoice INV-90212 with expedite fee and justification. Approving now.
jamie_ops: Thanks. Follow-ups: 1) confirm consolidated AWB number in thread, 2) alex to run pre-stage commands once AWB confirmed, 3) lia to attach final invoice to PO, 4) sam to confirm pickup time.
lia_vendor: AWB confirmed: 1ZEXP1234567890. Manifest uploaded: MAN-78421-v2. RM-8921 includes serials and depot notes.
alex_infra: Running prep when you confirm pickup. Will tag nodes and start image pulls on go.
sam_logistics: Pickup confirmed 18:45 CET. ETA staging: +36h from pickup -> approx 06:45 CET in 2 days.
jamie_ops: Great. Postmortem note: track cost vs avoided SLA credits; if we repeat expedite >2x in month we need a standing reserve. @matt_finance please flag budget line for vendor expedite buffer.
matt_finance: Will add a €25k buffer line to monthly ops forecast and flag in the next finance sync.
lia_vendor: Closing loop: vendor to dispatch after credit release (done), AWB live, RM-8921 linked. I will ping when customs completes release. :truck: :package:
jamie_ops: Thank you all. Keeping thread for final ETA and invoice reconciliation.
